prompt_version: v2 (v1 had a real defect: inferred CONTRADICTED/UNSUPPORTED from an unaddressed overclaim or incomplete multi-fact coverage rather than PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED - same class of defect as Candidate B's original F1 finding, independently discovered and independently fixed here with different wording)
schema_version: prompt-described JSON shape (NOT provider response_format/json_schema - see independence_rationale)

generation_settings.reasoning_disabled_rationale: Nemotron-3-Super is reasoning-capable by default; verified live that leaving thinking enabled burns the entire max_tokens budget on chain-of-thought before any final answer, causing finish_reason=length with no usable output.

independence_rationale: Genuinely distinct provider (NVIDIA NIM) and model family (Nemotron 3 Super, a dense/MoE Llama-lineage model) from Cerebras qwen-3.8-27b (Candidate B / Phase-6 generator) and from Google Gemini (Candidate D). Isolated inputs: claim text + cited Evidence content/metadata only - no Candidate B or Candidate D outputs, no gold labels, no generator prompt/reasoning ever included in any Candidate E request.
code_gemini_dependency: NONE - grounding_eval/nvidia_judge.py has zero imports from grounding_eval/gemini_judge.py or grounding_eval/judge.py; batching/schema-validation logic independently reimplemented
response_format_note: NVIDIA's native `response_format: json_schema` strict mode was tried first and triggers a genuine model-side degenerate-repetition decoding failure (confirmed live: valid JSON prefix, then infinite whitespace-token loop until max_tokens exhausted, finish_reason=length). Switched to prompt-described JSON shape + explicit deterministic parsing/validation instead - documented, not hidden.

residual_known_imperfections: P7V2-MS1-S: gold supported, predicted partially_supported - both cited facts are actually fully supported by the real Evidence (verified by direct inspection); the model appears to hedge toward partially_supported when a compound claim combines a trial-identity fact with a separate approval fact, even when both are correct.

P7V2-MS3-P: gold partially_supported, predicted unsupported - the model treats the claim's most specific sub-fact (a dosing detail entirely absent from the cited evidence) as the 'core assertion', rather than recognizing the also-present, also-cited, correct trial-identity facts as sufficient for partially_supported.
development_metrics.decision: NOT further prompt-tuned - these are genuine but minor boundary-interpretation edge cases (both involve WHICH sub-fact of a multi-fact claim counts as 'the core assertion', an inherently softer judgment than the F1-class defect already fixed), and further iteration risks an unproductive prompt-tuning loop. Development already exceeds all predeclared thresholds (macro-F1 0.945 >= 0.90, unsupported/contradiction recall 1.0 >= 0.95).
